entities.name: Horobi
entities.description: A terrifying kami of death from Kamigawa with a horned skull face, drawn to pain and suffering.

entities.name: Reito Massacre
entities.description: Event after which Horobi came into being.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Kitanosu heard the wailing.

entities.name: Kitanosu
entities.description: Nezumi village that heard Horobi's wailing.

entities.name: Forked-Tongue
entities.description: Shaman who identified Horobi and advised sacrificing a life, then hid in her treasury.

entities.name: Sonokura
entities.description: Human mercenary, fallen into disrepair, sacrificed to Horobi.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Horobi fought both sides.

events.summary: Kitanosu hears unsettling wailing; shaman Forked-Tongue identifies Horobi and advises sacrificing a life every third night it appeared.
events.quote: advised that the village must sacrifice a life to appease the spirit every third night it appeared

events.summary: The village leaders decide to sacrifice the mercenary Sonokura, luring him to the outskirts, binding him and cutting his leg tendons.
events.quote: his leg tendons cut to ensure he couldn't escape

events.summary: Horobi appears, drawn to Sonokura's suffering, and devours him, leaving bones and worms, absorbing his voice into its chorus.
events.quote: Sonokura's voice was absorbed into the kami's chorus of wails

events.summary: Forked-Tongue sits in her treasury, knowing the sacrifices keep Horobi away from her belongings.
Horobi fights both sides in the New Phyrexian Invasion, killing Phyrexians and Kamigawans.
events.quote: Horobi fought against both sides during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: advised the sacrifice to protect her treasures
relations.quote: the shaman who had guided the villagers to make the sacrifice
